# Define a pattern for airline names, which can be adjusted as needed
airline_pattern = r'^(HELLOFLIGHT|United Airlines|Delta|American Airlines|Southwest Airlines|Allegiant Air)$'

def standardize_airlines(value):
    # Check if the value matches any of the airline names in the pattern
    match = re.match(airline_pattern, value.lower())

    # If a match is found, return the standardized airline name (case-insensitive)
    if match:
        return match.group(0).upper()
    else:
        # If no match is found, return the original value unchanged
        return value

# Apply the function to each row in the 'src' column
cleaned_src = df['src'].apply(standardize_airlines)

# Count the number of unique airline carriers recorded
num_airlines = len(cleaned_src.unique())

print("Number of unique airline carriers:", num_airlines)
return value
